subject: Risk signoff + pricing concession request — Aurora Life (sanctions & KYC checks)
messages:
From: Tom Reyes <t.reyes@auroralife.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Sep 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal and SOW + ask for discount and compliance checks

Marissa —

Thanks again for the product walkthrough earlier this week. Attached is the SOW we discussed (Aurora_Life_SOW_v1.pdf). Two quick asks from our side to move forward:

1) Pricing: Our procurement team has asked if Redwood can offer a 30% one-time onboarding credit for the pilot (our standard internal ask for new vendors).
2) Compliance: We need confirmation that Redwood can pass our export control and sanctions screening for the solution, and that PII handling aligns with our procurement checklist. We have operations in multiple APAC markets and a small engineering team in Eastern Europe — please confirm any flags we should expect.

Can you loop in the appropriate people? We are aiming to sign before the end of the month.

Tom Reyes
Head of Platform Partnerships
Aurora Life

Attachments: Aurora_Life_SOW_v1.pdf (application/pdf, 312 KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reyes <t.reyes@auroralife.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Sep 2027 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal and SOW + ask for discount and compliance checks

Tom — thanks for the SOW and clear asks. Looping in Neha (security/compliance), Logan (finance/pricing), and Stephanie (deal desk) to get fast answers.

Internal note / asks for the thread:
- Neha: please run a sanctions/export-control screen and flag any cross-border processing concerns. If there are controls we can put in the contract (e.g., geo-restrictions, data routing clauses), note those so we can keep the deal moving.
- Logan: Tom is requesting a 30% onboarding credit (one-time). What's our flexibility here for a customer of this profile? Proposed quick alternative: a 20% onboarding credit + milestone-based credits tied to usage.
- Stephanie: if approval or a non-standard concession memo is required, please advise next steps for exec signoff.

Tom — we'll come back with a consolidated response today or early tomorrow.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0132

Attachments: sanctions_screen_request.csv (text/csv, stub)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Sep 2027 18:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal and SOW + ask for discount and compliance checks

Team — quick findings from the initial review:

1) Sanctions screen: No direct matches on individuals or entities in OFAC/UK/UN lists. See attached CSV (auroralife_sanctions_screen_20270912.csv) for the automated output.

2) Export control risk: Aurora Life has engineering operations in Ukraine/Russia-adjacent contractors (noted in their procurement questionnaire). That raises potential export-control considerations for certain ML models and any cryptographic export compliance.

3) Data residency and PII: Their SOW mentions analytics processing that could include health-adjacent signals. We need a contract addendum that:
   - Limits cross-border model-hosting for any regulated datasets (customer to ensure workloads classified as regulated are routed to approved regions)
   - Adds an operational audit right for one-time sampling during pilot

Risk-based recommendation: We can proceed with the pilot under a conditional approval: allow deployment but require the following controls in the SOW/contract before signing —
   - Redact or exclude regulated datasets from the pilot scope;
   - Add geo-routing clause (US/EU-only processing for regulated data);
   - Quarterly compliance attestations from Aurora;
   - 20% onboarding credit (instead of 30%), conditional on completion of a short KYC pack and receipt of the audit attestation.

If the customer pushes back on the controls, escalate to execs for a full exception.

Neha Kapoor
Head of Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com

Attachments: auroralife_sanctions_screen_20270912.csv (text/csv, stub)

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Tom Reyes <t.reyes@auroralife.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal and SOW + ask for discount and compliance checks

Thanks everyone — internal decision: we will approve the pilot with the conditional concessions Neha outlined. Final terms we can offer today:

- Commercial: 20% one-time onboarding credit (applies upon SOW signature). No other pricing concessions.
- Contract: include the geo-routing/data-residency addendum and an operational audit clause limited to pilot scope.
- Compliance: Aurora to provide KYC pack (company ownership chart + LEI or equivalent) and sign an attestation on regulated-data exclusion for the pilot.

Marissa / Stephanie — please document this in the deal memo and attach the proposed contract addendum. Marissa, you can share these terms with Tom; if Aurora accepts, finance will prepare the credit memo and legal will push the addendum.

Tom — appreciate the quick turnaround. If you accept these conditional terms, we can cut the onboarding credit and aim to start the pilot next week.

Regards,
Logan Wright
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com
